column1: # TITLE: Analysis of the lncRNA-miRNA-mRNA network reveals a potential regulatory mechanism of EGFR-TKIs resistance in NSCLC

column2: to investigate the underlying molecular mechanisms of how EGFR-TKIs resistance occurs in NSCLC
column3: we examined gene expression using microarray technology on gefitinib-resistant NSCLC cells to obtain differentially expressed (DE) lncRNAs and mRNAs. Then we carried out KEGG enrichment analysis for DE-mRNAs and constructed the ceRNA regulatory network of DE-lncRNAs and DE-mRNAs. Our results revealed the downregulated lncRNA LINC01128 acted as ceRNA to decrease PTEN via sponging miR-25-3p
column4: and then the signal reactions caused by the reduction of PTEN would activate PI3K/Akt signaling pathway
column5: which may lead to the development of drug resistance to EGFR-TKIs in NSCLC. Our findings will provide a novel perspective for the underlying molecular mechanisms of EGFR-TKIs resistance in NSCLC. Besides
column6: this research will help to develop new therapeutic targets for EGFR-TKIs resistance in NSCLC.
